scope: Code-only adaptation and real Python AST/CLI checks. No browser, media, local-build or online acceptance executed.

                           [--release-version RELEASE_VERSION] [--out OUT]

options:

                        Site base including /video-studio; omit to serve built
                        site locally

                        Actual published release version for canonical mode;

options:

usage: site-color-compare.py [-h] --browser BROWSER --out OUT

Compare exact native Canvas PNGs against explicit accurate BT.709 RGB. This is
a native-decoder comparison at full 1920x1080, separate from preview lossy
comparisons on any reduced sampling grid.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --browser BROWSER
  --out OUT

usage: site-verify-online.py [-h] --version VERSION --commit COMMIT
                             [--out OUT]

P10 complete ordinary HTTPS GET identity checks, separate from native browser
QA. Pages exposes derived HTML/VTT and media, not raw meta/storyboard JSON.
Those JSON bytes are additionally read from the declared Git commit on GitHub.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --version VERSION
  --commit COMMIT
  --out OUT

usage: site-reading-supplement.py [-h] [--base-url BASE_URL] [--out OUT]

Inspect P10 article and complete source panels using actual input gestures.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --base-url BASE_URL
  --out OUT
